svg.aria-label: Cascade diagram: 12 visual checks multiplied by 3 viewports, 2 browsers and 220 runs per month equals 15,840 billable screenshots per month, crossing a 5,000 free tier.
svg.title: How 12 visual checks become 15,840 billable screenshots per month
svg.text: Twelve checks is how you count. Fifteen thousand screenshots is how you're billed. Every multiplier was added for a good reason.
